_comment: AGENT: always read this file via the task-index-manager skill before reading or writing any task state. System tracker for ai-worldbuilder (ADR 002).

tasks.title: ADR 004 and glossary: one cell journal; drop region backup/restore
tasks.notes: Write ADR 004: single append-only registry/journal.jsonl (begun->landed/mismatched); progress, ghost state, ownership, in-flight are views of it; site_kit.apply keeps signature/guards and is the only writer via change(). Decisions: NO region backup/restore anywhere; evidence is lidar only; worlds are volatile for this phase (erase and recreate, no migration). Update GLOSSARY ('Apply journal', 'Cell registry'). Mark ADR 003 s3 and docs/specs/lidar-ghost-v2-and-dryrun-reset.md superseded; delete the drifted .scratch/lidar-ghost-v2-dryrun copy. Design sources: merged A/B/C designs (design-A/B/C.md from the design session).

tasks.title: Remove pristine baseline reads; evidence is lidar only
tasks.notes: Delete every read of config/world.json pristine_region_path: scripts/lidar_heightmap.py (pristine Maps default), scripts/lump_scan.py, scripts/osm_footprints.py (PRISTINE World), config key, rules/docs/skills mentions, tests. Anything needing ground/surface heights uses the lidar provider only. Check rules/ and templates/ for 'pristine' wording.

tasks.title: Decide and replace read-only region block reads (site_kit.World)
tasks.notes: site_kit.World parses r.X.Z.mca read-only; also used by lump_scan, osm_footprints, readback, site_recover. We are nervous about direct region-file reads. Audit every caller (including any shutil/open wb writers we missed), then decide: read blocks over MCP instead, or keep a single guarded reader behind the BlockStore seam (LiveBlocks + MemoryBlocks). Output: decision recorded in ADR 004 and the BlockStore interface.

tasks.title: Remove region backup and restore entirely
tasks.notes: Delete scripts/region_backup.py (snap, snap-world, restore, prune, kinds), registry_repair backup/undo-repair/export-import slice, model_bakeoff restore-ghost and ghost_snap/ghost_region_path config, dryrun_reset region wipe-by-file (reset becomes erase-and-recreate), site_recover region snapshot compare if it depends on it, logout_gate if nothing else needs it, rules/cleanup.md prune notes, process.md and handoff-layered-passes snapshot/restore advice, cell-orchestrator and model-bakeoff skills, and their tests. Replacement for 'mess in a cell': reconcile(fix) wipes/replays recorded plans over MCP (see task 44). Replacement for the bakeoff baseline: regenerate lidar ghosts via lidar_ghost apply (see task 48).

tasks.title: Journal-based cell registry core with MemoryBlocks
tasks.notes: Implement CellRegistry: change(intent) as the only writer (Build, Undo, Note), view() returning frozen per-cell CellView, reconcile(cells, fix=) comparing journal to blocks. BlockStore seam with LiveBlocks and MemoryBlocks adapters; ownership as a private rebuildable projection (replaces *-cells.json, pickle cache, owner index). Loud failures, no swallow-and-print. Tests at the interface only. No Snapshot/Restore intents (task 40).

tasks.title: Cut site_kit.apply over to the journal
tasks.notes: apply keeps signature, guards and SystemExit messages; calls change(Build). Delete scripts/site_stages.py, scripts/registry_hooks.py, the swallow-and-print try blocks in site_kit, built_cells/owned_in/owner index/cache, touched_cells.py; reroute readers (feature_build, house_build, terrace, ground_layer, trees_layer, decor_layer, cell_marker, redo_here, coverage, site_status, site_handoff, registry_next). Delete old tests as each path goes.

tasks.title: Cut ghosts over: derive ghost state, strip stored ghost stages
tasks.notes: lidar_ghost keeps plan builders and heights only (GhostPlanner). Delete its STAGES/registry state functions (about 18); ghost ground/features/frontier derived from the journal; real Build supersedes ghost ground, strips overlapping ghost features and ensures the ring-2 frontier as follow-up entries. Fix test_lidar_ghost (ring 1, STAGES-as-store).

tasks.title: Cut undo, mask undo, strip, recover and repair over to reconcile
tasks.notes: mask_undo.finish_undo, strip_cell_above_ground (no direct STAGES write), site_recover, redo_here become Undo/reconcile. Cell repair = reconcile(cells, fix=True): detect foreign/missing blocks, re-commit recorded plans over MCP; no region copies. Verify the possible registry_repair_wipe bogus-feature bug is gone.

tasks.title: Dry-run reset as erase-and-recreate
tasks.notes: dryrun_reset: empty world, fresh journal, rescaffold site/ from templates; no region file copying. Worlds are volatile this phase.

tasks.title: Purge stale rules, docs, prompts, templates, world docs
tasks.notes: Work through the audit top-10: process.md:25 and handoff-layered-passes (STAGES 'journal only'), site_handoff.py hand-edit-STAGES and QUEUE/'end Q-nnn' strings, handoff-layered-passes s11 site/REGISTRY.json proposal, templates/empty-world/README.txt, worlds/southampton-build AGENTS/README/HUMANS.html/site/*.txt (own git repo) and retired QUEUE/CURRENT-CELL files, coverage.py signoff, ADR/spec status lines, model-bakeoffs README/PROTOCOL/rounds snap names, skills (model-bakeoff, cell-orchestrator, human-confirm-fix). One canonical doc per fact; others link, do not copy. Remove tests that encode old behaviour (test_site_handoff QUEUE round-trip, test_coverage signoffs, etc.).

tasks.title: Stale-terms guard so old instructions cannot creep back
tasks.notes: Add a check (cell_registry verify and/or a test) that fails on banned terms outside the ADR/history: site_stages, registry_hooks, snap --bbox, snap-world, restore-ghost, archive_stale, pristine_region_path, QUEUE.txt, signoff, STAGES.json. Run it in the normal test command.

tasks.title: Recreate worlds and rerun bakeoff R-004 with a lidar-ghost baseline
tasks.notes: Wipe and recreate southampton-build and the bakeoff world; regenerate the 3x3 (ring 2) ghosts with lidar_ghost apply; commit R-004 (open, Claude Haiku 5.5 high effort, feature_design) and run the sitting. Update model-bakeoffs PROTOCOL/README/SKILL to the no-restore flow.
